name: What is the difference between fence stability restoration and full fence replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between fence stability restoration and full fence replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fence stability restoration focuses on repairing specific issues that cause instability, such as damaged posts or panels, to extend the life of an existing fence. Full fence replacement involves removing the entire old fence and installing a new one. Restoration is typically more cost-effective and less disruptive if the majority of the fence structure is still sound, whereas replacement is needed when the fence is beyond repair or a complete aesthetic change is desired.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration repairs specific issues to extend an existing fence's life, while replacement involves installing an entirely new fence.
